name: ChainSentinel
title: ChainSentinel · Free pre-interaction veto gate for AI agents
description: A free, zero-signup pre-interaction veto gate for TRON / BTC / ETH addresses. Checks the OFAC SDN sanctioned-address list (906 entries) plus 2 public records, then reports live on-chain activity. This is NOT a full AML/KYT investigation: no entity attribution, no multi-hop tracing, no KYT reports. Every response carries a coverage object stating exactly what was checked, what was not, and a recommendedAction. green is never a clearance. High-volume use is paid with non-custodial TRON USDT prepaid credits (x402-inspired, not an official x402 integration).

skills.name: Check an address before interacting with it
skills.description: Checks a TRON/BTC/ETH address against the OFAC SDN / curated list plus live on-chain activity. Returns level, score, reasons, evidence links and a coverage object (verdictBasis, checksPerformed, notCovered, noData, recommendedAction). Always branch on coverage.recommendedAction; green means 'not found in our list', NOT 'clean funds'.
examples: Quick veto check on this TRON address before receiving USDT

skills.name: Check prepaid balance
skills.description: Read remaining USD credits and call count for a cs_agent_* credential.
examples: How many API calls do I have left?

skills.name: Get top-up instructions
skills.description: Return the TRON USDT payment address, price per call, minimum top-up and exact machine-followable steps. A one-time quote (POST /api/v1/quote) is required before paying: its unique 6-decimal amount binds the transfer to the claim.
examples: I got a 402 PAYMENT_REQUIRED, what do I do?

compliance: Read-only, best-effort pre-interaction screening. No entity attribution, no multi-hop tracing, no KYT reports, no court-admissible evidence. No trading execution, no custody, no private keys, no sanctions-evasion assistance. Risk signals, not legal advice or a compliance clearance.
note: This is a discovery document in the agent-card convention. The service is a stateless REST/JSON-RPC API, not an A2A task-based agent.
